description: Stage one rejects: reason 100 'INVALID CARD NUMBER FOUND'. Everything is case01's seed except that XREFFILE holds cardxref row 0 - card 0500024453765740 - instead of the row that resolves dailytran row 0's card, so the READ at :383 reports the INVALID KEY condition and :385-387 store 100 and its text. 1500-VALIDATE-TRAN then takes the ELSE at :374, so 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT NEVER RUNS: this is the one short-circuit in the cascade, and the account and category-balance datasets come back byte-identical to their seeds to prove it. :214 increments WS-REJECT-COUNT and 2500-WRITE-REJECT-REC writes exactly 430 bytes - the 350-byte DALYTRAN-RECORD copied verbatim by the group move at :447, then WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON as '0100' and WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC right-space-padded to its declared 76. Because WS-REJECT-COUNT is greater than zero, :230 moves 4 into RETURN-CODE.
